final_message: Task 6 done: each .manifest.json entry now records mermaidCliVersion and mermaidConfigHash, and a cached file is skipped only when both match the current values. Found and fixed a docs:build failure left by task 5: config.mts still named SVGs from the diagram code alone, so pages pointed at SVGs that did not exist. Both sides now use the exported mermaidSvgId. Rewrote the cache tests without any or unused arguments and added cases for redraw after config or version changes, for old-format entries, and for matching page and SVG names. Updated task 6 and the results section in the ticket; item_status was not changed. docs:build passes with chromium-headless-shell and rendered 174 SVGs with mermaid-cli 12.0.0. Redrawing of existing SVGs is covered only by unit tests because this worktree had no earlier public/mermaid. Task 4 (a person checking 3 or more diagrams) is still open.
